annotations.description: WEBPET-3823: after the Time Out correction is saved, the Job Cards tab preview keeps the pre-save 4 h card (the preview is requested before the save commits and never refreshed), so the spec reopens the screen and re-analyses before reading the preview. The correction itself is proved on the time card via the API before that.

The four catalog variations (late-found time card, wrong crew job, export-identifier mismatch, bad group piece-out distribution), the Transfer screen's own Reverse, the edited-job-card confirm path and the export/lock-blocked path are deferred: D5 covers the WEBPET-2050 happy path only.
